paragraphs.text: Konda's Banner was a legendary equipment on the plane of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War . Konda's Banner is a famous banner used by Daimyo Takeshi Konda - one of the greatest human rulers of Kamigawa. It symbolized his rule and was displayed on the back of his horse as he rode to battle, empowering his allies. The symbol on it is a crescent facing upwards with a circle between its edges. It was likely destroyed after his defeat in the Kami War .
